nom: Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Skin Activator Neck and Chest Cream

avis.texte: I really like this cream. It's not sticky at all and feels very smooth on the skin. It won't perform miracles overnight, but with consistent use, it visibly improves skin hydration and gives it a healthier, more refreshed appearance. It absorbs well without leaving any greasy residue, which I appreciate. A solid, reliable moisturizer for anyone looking for gradual but noticeable results.

avis.titre: Hydrating, but too heavy for daily use on my face.
avis.texte: The neck, chest, and face cream comes in a tube, so you can squeeze the tube to acquire the desired amount. A little goes a long way, so you don't have to use much to nourish your skin. The formula has no scent and is gentle enough for those who experience irritation from perfumed products. The cream has a thick consistency and leaves skin feeling soft and nourished. I did, however, opt to stop using it on my face and only use it on my neck and chest as I realized the formula was too heavy to use on my face.

I took a chance on this and tried it on my hands the first night. This was the first cream I've tried that didn't make my hands feel like they had residue on them or that they were greasy. I also woke up with smooth hands. I have continued to use it in other areas that have lost some elasticity or the texture could be improved. This is such an amazing substitute for the more pricier options out there with similar ingredients. Definitely worth it!

avis.titre: Good skin item to have with a purpose beyond hydra
avis.texte: Cetaphile is a well known trusted brand, this item is suitable for sensitive skin so it shouldn't cause breakouts and still has valuable ingredients of aha ans cica to not only hydrate your skin but to also help with firmness. It feels good on the skin.

avis.titre: Targeted hydration for delicate neck and chest ski
avis.texte: I appreciate that this cream is formulated specifically for the neck and chest—areas that are often overlooked in skincare routines. The texture is creamy and deeply moisturizing, and my skin feels smoother and more hydrated after each use. With continued application, the area looks more supple and well cared for. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin and didn't cause any irritation. Overall, it's a thoughtful addition to a targeted skincare routine focused on hydration and skin support.

This cream is of a great consistency and is absorbed easily by the skin. I can tell that it is high quality and not too greasy. I used it on my neck and chest and did not have any bad skin reactions or breakouts, whereas lower quality lotion can cause them. It quickly softened my skin on my arms after one application. I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: A good moisturizer cream for aging skin!
avis.texte: The texture is light, non-fragrant, and it absorbs quickly, leaving a thin, firming effect on the skin. This makes it particularly suitable for aging, thinning, or fragile skin. It's almost a perfect moisturizer cream, but I don't like the firming that it leaves after using, although it makes my skin moisturized quickly
I use this product daily! I really love the effects. I have fewer wrinkles and smoother skin. The consistency is throughout, and glides on effortlessly!

I've been using the Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest, and Face Cream for a bit, and overall it's a solid, no-nonsense product. The texture is rich without feeling heavy, and it absorbs nicely into the skin. I like that it's gentle enough for sensitive areas but still feels like it's doing something. With regular use, my skin looks a little smoother and more hydrated, especially around my neck. The firming effect is subtle, but there's a noticeable softening and plumping that makes everything look a bit more refreshed. Not a miracle cream, but dependable and easy to work into a daily routine.

If your skin is seeking major hydration then Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream is what you need! This cream means business it's on the thicker side but melts into thirsty skin easily. No scent and no greasy feeling left after use. Your skin feels immediately softer and more hydrated. Plumps up and firms wrinkly skin nicely with everyday use. Bottle is perfect size to just pop into your purse and go.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love using this product morning and night on my neck. Although it says it can be used on the face, I prefer using more of a gel moisturizer on my zone. I did try this on my face a few times but it's just not something I have gotten use to. I do the the results when using this on my neck, however. I feel like the formula is more creamy so it lasts longer than a regular lotion. The only downside is I wish the bottle was a bit bigger because I do enjoy this product.

The body isn't the only concern us men have. We, too, dont want saggy, crepey looking necks. This Hydrating and Firming neck cream from Cetaphil is a little thicker than the body lotion but still rubs in pretty clean while firming all that saggy skin that comes with aging, making sure i look healthy and hydrated from head to toe!

Effortlessly activate cell turnover with Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Face, Neck & Chest Cream. For all skin, however most importantly, for all cells. Wake them up and turn them over! Rating & Review reflect my honest opinion, but were provided to participate in a Sweepstakes.

The Cetaphil chest and neck hydrating and firming cream is amazing. The cream is easy to apply, the tube is easy to use. We have been using twice a day and can see some great improvements. The lotion is not sticky, does not leave a residue on sheets. Our skin seems to bounce back when pressed/ massaged. We will be purchasing this in the future.

I had a terrible allergic reaction to something in this products. I was not able to review it in its entirety for that reason. Posting because I have to.
Great product! I love it doesn't have any fragrance. I love the texture. The packaging is neat and safe. It is effective and skin feels really soft and refreshed after.

I love this moisturizer - I find the neck and upper chest tend to be really neglected, but face cream is too $$$ to use there while body cream is just too thick. This is a great mix that I think has provided lots of moisture and also collagen building that has helped my décolletage to just glow! It's made me more exited to wear deep-cut shirts to show off fantastic skin.

Best moisturizer Cetaphil has come out with! I've been using this cream for about a month and my skin looks radiant and clear. My fine lines have diminished and my neck and under chin look firmer. Even though it gently exfoliates skin, it doesn't cause dryness. It's just the right amount of moisture. I am 69 years old this month and while I have pretty good skin, this has taken it to the next level. The strangest part of all is that I have been asked twice for ID when buying alcohol in grocery store. I haven't been asked for ID in over 25 years. I hope Cetaphil continues to come out with more great products. Im scared with all the great reviews, it will be hard to keep in stock.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way

It's an easy product to incorporate in to my skincare routine, especially because I use it in areas I often neglect to put my current routine on. It doesn't leave any sticky or oily residue either, and I've not felt any pilling of the product as well.

I have received this product complementary exchange for my honest review. This one is my own personal favorite! This product is extremely hydrating. I love putting it on my face and on my skin. I've been using this skin-restoring cream on my chest, neck, and face, and I must say that I'm really impressed. avis.texte: It firmed up my skin and made it look so much healthier. There is no scent at all which is amazing. It absorbs right into your skin so there is no residue or oily feeling to your face,neck and chest. The texture is very soft and creamy

No strong smell, very thick consistency, hydrates the skin and leaves skin feeling rejuvenated. Looking forward to see the results in a couple more weeks . Great quantity in each product. No harsh chemicals or ingredients. Pretty basic packaging but great quantity!

Love the packaging. The texture to this firming cream went on soft and smooth there no stickiness to it at all it dry up fast. The scent is so light. I love how it makes my face and neck look.

avis.titre: Firm skin, youthful skin, less crepey skin =amazin
avis.texte: I Love how fast this cream soaks in and leaves my skin feeling fresh. After a few weeks, I can definitely tell my skin looks smoother and more toned. The cetaphil hydrating and firming cream is lightweight but very moisturizing, and it never irritates my skin. It gives me a healthy, firm looking skin that lasts all day.

Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream with CICA (Centella Asiatica) and AHA (Mandelic Acid) has a thick texture that absorbs quickly. I have been cleansing, applying a serum, and then applying a layer of the Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream to my face, neck, and chest. It gives an instant boost of moisture and with consistent use, it helps repair your skin barrier. My skin feels great, no breakouts or dry patches. I've noticed a big difference in my hands and the spot where my neck and chin meet. You get a lot of product in a convenient squeeze tube that lasts a long time.

I use this cream at night on my neck and decolletage. I use this as a preventative anti-aging cream and so far I've noticed that my skin feels smoother and looks firmer. The cream is very thick, so a little goes a long way and the tube will last awhile.

avis.titre: Targeted Care for Neck, Chest & Face
avis.texte: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest, and Face Cream is a standout in my skincare lineup. The formula feels rich yet smooth, and it absorbs well without being heavy or greasy. I love that it's designed specifically for delicate areas like the neck and chest, which often need extra care. After using it consistently, I've noticed my skin feels firmer, more hydrated, and overall healthier-looking. It's also gentle and fragrance-free, so I don't have to worry about irritation. This cream gives me that extra boost of hydration while supporting firmness in areas that show signs of aging first.

I've been looking for a product to help tighten the skin on my face, neck and chest and the Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream helps with all three areas. The cream is unscented, dermatologist recommended, and doesn't clog pores which is important to me. I've been using this for about a month and have seen the greatest improvement on my neck. Great product!
Sensitive skin fragrance free product I used in face and chest. Product has no scent and is not greasy. It has worked well to reduce fine lines on my face. This will be my new go to!
Take tired and saggy skin and make it supple and strong. Consistency is kind of thick. Fits easily in your purse and no smell. This stuff works amazingly.

This face and neck cream has no scent and is full of moisture packed ingredients that over time should help skin elasticity and creepiness. The texture is super smooth and is the perfect step in my morning and nighttime skin routine.

avis.titre: Super nice new product from cetaphil!
avis.texte: I always trust cetaphil to take care of my sensitive skin. This product is the next step to help hydrating and firming my skin especially on the neck area (hard to take care of). I love how small it is and I can take it with me in my purse! No strong scent which is also a plus!

A little bit of this face cream definitely goes a long way even to use down through your neck. It's not heavy and don't cause any breakouts, which was a concern of mine. It's a great hydrating cream, as far as firming goes, I'm not sure I've noticed a difference.

avis.titre: Amazing cream for neck, face, chest that plumps &
avis.texte: So happy Cetaphil developed firming cream specifically for neck, chest & face! It really made a difference with my skin feeling supple & glowy. I noticed a difference within a few days for my neck/chest area. I can wear lower neck clothing with confidence. I use twice a day, morning & night. I love the fact that it contains AHA to increase cell turnover which reduced fine lines. I even used this on my temples towards eye area to reduce laugh lines. I have the last laugh cuz my wrinkles are minimal. Cetaphil is definitely a game changer at a great price point. I suspect that I will reap more results in the coming winter months. I live in a cold state and get dry skin in the winter. When I take walks or run outside, I will apply the cream all over my face. This cream is ahhhhmazing.

Thick cream that absorbs quickly. Bo greasy feeling left behind. Does feel a little sticky when dry. Abused it on my face and neck and bo issues with breakouts. No scent which is great. Packaging makes it easy to use.
Creamy lightly scented lotion that melts quickly into the skin. Immediate noticeable results with long term benefits . Contains AHA and CIRCA. Simple clean packaging

A gentle face and neck cream with a medium consistency. It absorbs quickly and leaves skin firm and smooth. It has no strong odors. The tube makes it great to carry with you all day for easy reapplication.

It does have the right ingredients to help make your skin firmer if they could improve the texture of the cream, then I would definitely use this daily.

I really enjoy using this neck, chest, and face firming cream. After using it regularly, I realized how much I had been neglecting my neck. I also like that it has no fragrance, so even people with sensitivity can use it. The compact packaging makes it easy to carry in my bag and use on the go. This cream is definitely staying in my routine.

I am definitely impressed with Cetaphil products. They are so hydrating and worth the price. This neck, chest, and face cream works wonders. I did not use it on my face, but did use it on my neck and chest. It's very moisturizing, which is important to me. This cream doesn't have a scent.
The scent is barely there and the packaging and the ingredients sounds about right. The texture is very lightweight and glides onto the skin so beautifully with effectively
This is a very thick product. It feels a little greasy but seems to absorb well. I haven't noticed a huge difference in the firmness of the skin on my neck. It dies moisturize very well though!

Easy to carry around in purse and travel bag. I know its important to start young putting on products to help with skin later in life. I feel like this will be a benefit for sure but cant tell immediately. I do like the softness of the texture and doesn't leave a slime residue afterwards.

I've discovered an absolute gem in moisturizer that offers unbeatable value for the price! The Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Cream Skin Activator is a great pick for aging skin. It deeply hydrates, helps improve elasticity, and leaves skin feeling smoother and firmer without any heaviness. Gentle yet effective — perfect for daily use on mature, sensitive skin.
I love ice cream. I love the packaging. It's not big or small. I could fit it in my purse. It's good for sensitive skin and aging skin. Would use again.

Wow! I used this at night as my moisturizer and after a week or so people kept commenting on my skin and appearance. Everyone was saying I had a glow! I noticed more even texture and color myself. The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & firming cream came well packaged, and works pretty good. It makes skin feel soft, smooth, and moisturized. I use it on my face and neck it goes on nice and is not greasy. It doesn't really have a scent, and is good for dry skin. It definitely hydrates my skin.

Cetaphil is well known for their dermatologist recommended products and this one says it's for sensitive skin. I've been using the product for three weeks, and I can honestly say that my neck appears to look firmer. And that hideous neck line that we all loathe, it doesn't seem as predominant. It does feel really hydrated, which is really the intended goal of the lotion, in my opinion.
So not to crazy about this lotion. It's thicker than I'd like and takes a little longer to apply. The bottling is nice though. No scent which I like. The ingredients are what I like.

This cream is very hydrating. I like how it contains a gentle AHA (Mandelic Acid) to remove dead skin and increase skin turnover, plus Centella Asiatica (CICA) to soothe and restore skin's moisture barrier. As I'm getting older, I find my neck and chest needs something more to reduce crepey skin. I use this cream both morning and night and can see a change in firmness and skin looks more plump and smooth after continuous use. It absorbs into skin quickly and best of all, is unscented. I used a more expensive cream specifically for this area, but will definitely switch to this cream to hydrate and firm my neck and décolletage instead.

avis.titre: Great lotion for your aging skin.

However, even with my sensitive skin, I was able to use it on my neck and around my ears without any irritation. A big plus, it has no perfumes scent and the tube package is great for traveling.

I also don't think I have the type of skin to truly show a difference if I were to do a before and after, but right now in life I am focused on maintaining or improving my skin. It's all about prevention. So hopefully in keeping with creams like this it will help my body. There's not much of a scent and it rubs in nice without feeling sticky or heavy. There's bottle is big enough to cover the body and I use other creams for certain areas I want to focus on.

I've been using the Cetaphil Hydrating Firming Face, Neck & Chest Cream on my neck and chest (not my face) and really like it. It's not greasy, doesn't settle into the neck lines, and never feels uncomfortable. I use it every night and have noticed some small improvements in how my skin looks and feels. A solid option for neck and chest care.

At 45, I've noticed my neck starting to show signs of aging with fine lines and a crepey look. After using it regularly, my neck feels more hydrated, looks firmer, and the skin is noticeably smoother.

Love this stuff, such a great moisturizer for the face super firming super hydrating for the skin. Has no scent which is great thing if you have sensitive skin, which I do. The Ingredients are super clean and the packaging explains it all.

Been loving Cetaphil for so long. This new line sounds very promising . Even I haven't noticed significant changes yet but it definitely gives my skin the moist and hydration my skin needs . It has no scent whatsoever and absorbed fast and leave no sticky feeling or anything .

avis.titre: Compact and non greasy firming lotion

I received this product thanks to Influenster and Cetaphil in exchange for my honest review. Lightweight and amazingly hydrating. I feel no scent on the cream. I use it every night and I'm very happy with the results.

I've been using the Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream, and it's quickly become one of my favorites. The skin on my neck and chest is more delicate than my face, and I've noticed some dryness and early signs of crepiness there. This cream has been amazing. The texture is lightweight but nourishing. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. After just a week, my skin started looking smoother and less crepey, especially around my neck. With continued use, I've noticed it feels a little firmer and more hydrated, which is exactly what I was hoping for. The formula uses mandelic acid (AHA) to gently encourage cell turnover, and CICA to help strengthen and restore the skin's barrier. Together, they make my skin look fresher and healthier without causing irritation , which is huge since my skin can be sensitive. I also love that it's fragrance-free, hypoallergenic, and safe for all skin types. I highly recommend this cream.

Comes in a tube . Easy to use . Non sticky and no fragrance. It leaves my skin hydrated immediately and does not looks greasy . Love the packaging . The ingredients like aha and cica helps to plump and help get smooth skin. It helps get firm skin. Skin looks smooth after use . Suit all skin type . A must have product. I highly recommend this

I receivedCetaphil Hydrating and Firming Cream Skin Activator for free in exchange for my honest review I recently tried out the new Cetaphil Hydrating and Firming Cream for the first time. It has skin activator compounds that penetrate deep to activate sleeping cells that help to firm up the skin. I have only used this a short time and cannot say much about the firming aspect, but there are several other things I noticed and liked. It is a thick formula so it is not messy and it absorbed well into my skin. Since the formula is thicker, you only need a small amount to get the job done. I also personally liked that it had almost no scent to it as well. I have fragrances I like to put on myself and do not like having my lotion compete with them. Overall I am happy with it and my skin is left hydrated and soft after each use.

I did not like this product. Personal preference is I like scented products better. This felt greasy and heavy on my face. When I woke up in the morning I felt like I had to wash this off because it had not yet absorbed into my skin. I wouldn't recommend. I also broke out on my cheeks from it.

I love that they made a version of this lotion for face and neck and chest - my neck and chest saw a huge difference in skin texture. I love the hydration, it is a little thicker for face but not too thick and not greasy. Very comfortable and I love that there is no scent. The tube makes it easy for neck and face.

avis.titre: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Ne
avis.texte: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest & Face Cream has quickly become one of my favorites! The texture is silky and nourishing but still feels lightweight, so it glides on beautifully and absorbs without leaving any residue. I especially love using it on my neck and chest, areas that often get overlooked but really show signs of aging. One thing that makes this cream extra special for me is how well it pairs with my tretinoin routine. After using tret, my skin can feel a bit irritated and fragile, and this cream soothes instantly while reinforcing my barrier. The CICA calms my skin, and the hydration lasts for hours, leaving me with a plump, comfortable glow. Over time, I've noticed my skin looking smoother and firmer, and the fact that it's fragrance-free and gentle makes me trust it even more. It's like a skin comfort blanket that also works hard behind the scenes to keep my skin healthy, firm, and radiant.

avis.titre: A New Favorite! Helps Form Neck and Chest
avis.texte: I loved Ceraphil's Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck,Chest, and Face Cream! I feel like there aren't many products out there for the neck and chest even though it's an important area to take care of/can sag and age over time. The cream absorbed well, didn't cause any breakouts, and helped firm my neck and chest area. This is my favorite product from this lineup and I will continue to use!

avis.titre: Maybe too greasy for some skin types?
avis.texte: This product worked fine, but I did feel like it left my face feeling greasy. I think if I continued to use it, I would skip my face and only use on my neck and chest. It is a neutral scent, if that's helpful for certain people.
I've been using this at night as my moisturizer and I really like it! My skin feels and looks hydrated and healthy. It has no scent and seems to be easy on the skin for those with sensitive skin.
First of all, I love that it's unscented and it won't irritate my skin. The texture of the lotion is not too heavy. The packaging is the same as the other Cetaphils

I was thrilled when I saw that Cetaphil had developed a line for aging skin! I've trusted Cetaphil for years to provide gentle, yet effective care to my skin. I was lucky enough to try three products in this line: the Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Lotion, Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Cream, and Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest, and Face Cream. Like all Cetaphil products, these are fragrance-free and non-irritating. I've tried all of them and the star of the show, in my humble opinion, is the Neck, Chest, and Face Cream. I'm 45 years old and my chest and neck are starting to get a slight crepey appearance (I would love to tell my younger self to stay out of the sun!). This cream absorbed immediately and I could see a difference within 2 days. It plumped my skin nicely and my skin felt soft and hydrated. The appearance of crepiness was definitely diminished. (I only used this product on my neck and chest as I have another more targeted product that I prefer for my face, which is not experiencing as much crepiness yet.) The other two products, the Skin Activator Hydrating and Firming Lotion and Hydrating & Firming Cream, are fantastic as well. Since we are at the end of summer here in the Midwest, and it's sweltering during the day, I started with the lotion. It's a perfect weight for daytime use and again delivered quick visible results. I prefer the cream for bedtime and cooler days when Mother Nature is not providing an additional boost of mo
Great for face, neck and chest. Does not feel oily, feels hydrating and refreshing and fights aging skin! I like using this at night but could use it in the morning as well.

avis.titre: My neck and chest look youthful again
avis.texte: I never paid much attention to my neck and chest before, but I decided to try the Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Cream for those areas. In just a couple of days, I noticed my skin looked smoother and less crepey. Now, after consistent use, my neck feels firmer and more youthful. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Worked well and made skin smoother
avis.texte: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Neck, Chest, & Face Cream worked very well. There was no scent which I liked. The lotion made my skin smoother immediately. I would recommend it.

This hydrating and firming cream from Cetaphil is great for all skin types. It's fragrance free so it's good for sensitive skin. This cream is thick but absorbs quickly and leaves your skin feeling refreshed and hydrated without being weighed down. I loved this for my face and neck it didn't cause any breakouts and leaves you with smooth skin.

I've spent a few weeks using this plus two others in this product line. As someone with very crepey skin, I'm always desperate to find something that works, and I will absolutely keep buying this. I did not use this specific product on my face, but did use it on my chest. I'm unclear how this differs from the lotion (maybe the AHA concentration?) I may just use the lotion for my chest area moving forward, but I'll do some more research first. Overall, I recommend!

avis.titre: Great nighttime cream for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and am sensitive to fragrance, so I love that this didn't irritate my skin and is fragrance-free. The tube makes it easy to get the right amount out without any waste like a pump. This absorbed fully into my skin without feeling heavy. Keep in mind some makeup products might pill on top of this, depending on the base; make sure the makeup base is the same as this cream for best results if wearing makeup. This does not have any sun protection, so I prefer to apply this as my PM moisturizer. I don't have crepey skin but could use some firming; I didn't notice any changes in the texture of my skin, but maybe I needed to use it longer to see results.

I've been using this cream for several weeks now and I'm really impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. My skin feels noticeably softer and more hydrated throughout the day, and I've started to see improvement in firmness around my neck and chest area. I love that it's gentle enough for sensitive skin while still being effective for mature skin like mine in my 40s. It has given my skin a smoother and healthier look, and I feel more confident about my overall appearance. This is definitely a product I'll keep in my daily routine.
Pleasant texture and scent. This cream vontains active ingredients and moisturizes the skin perfectly. Safe packaging. An excellent product for effective everyday use.
Nice non scented moisturizer for the face and neck, it plumped the area to smooth it out and didn't leave a greasy feeling on my face, while also not unbalancing it.

Has a very thick, creamy texture. No fragrance at all, but does have a very subtle odor at first, but it dissipates after a few minutes. Does seem to moisturize skin, although I have only been using on hands and arms. I tried it on my face but I didn't like the feel of it at all. A bit greasy feeling as well.

avis.titre: A Silky Shield That Locks in Hydration.
avis.texte: This cream is a specific treatment for the areas that reveal signs of aging the fastest: the neck, chest, and face. The texture is silky and comfortable—rich yet quickly absorbed—leaving a delightful sensation on the skin. I loved adding this cream as the final step of my skincare routine because it feels like a protective shield that locks in all the products applied before, helping them absorb perfectly. With consistent use, I noticed firmer, more even-looking skin. It feels deeply nourishing without being heavy, making it an excellent companion for an anti-aging routine that includes active ingredients such as retinoids. This cream ensures long-lasting hydration that keeps the skin calm and balanced while using stronger treatments.

Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Face + Neck + Chest Cream: Gentle but Seriously Effective 💧 I've been using Cetaphil's Hydrating & Firming Face, Neck & Chest Cream for about three weeks, and I'm honestly impressed. I started applying it after my evening cleanse, and the texture is rich but not greasy—it sinks in fast and leaves my skin feeling plump and smooth. The mandelic acid and CICA combo works quietly but noticeably. Within a few days, my neck looked less crepey and my chest felt more hydrated. What I really appreciate is how gentle it is—no tingling, no redness, just calm, nourished skin. It's fragrance-free, which I love, and it layers well with my other products. If you're dealing with thinning or fragile skin in those areas, this cream feels like a quiet little miracle.

I spent a good fortune on a similar product that claims to correct crepey skin. Unfortunately, I did not get any results. You can imagine my skeptiscm when I got this product. However, the Cetaphil Hydrating & Firming Cream Skin Activator did not let me down. I used it exactly as directed, twice daily. Within a week, I saw visible results with a smoother, firmer neck and chest. I'm very impressed with the ingredients including AHA (Mandelic Acid) and CICA (Centella Asiatica.) These ingredients work to deliver the ingredients deep into the surface skin layers to help activate sleeping cells for firmer less crepey skin. I'm very fussy with what I put on my neck and chest because I think they give away my age. I feel confident that I am using a product that delivers and I'm so happy there's no scent. This product is also paraben free and hypoallergenic. I'm not sure I could ask for more

I'm so impressed with how well this works and how amazing my skin feels after using it. My skin feels hydrated and soft and looks so good! I feel like this is a new staple that I will be using all the time!

avis.titre: good cream, didn't notice a difference in texture
avis.texte: I use this a good bit on my neck and face for the last month or so. I personally did not experience a significant change in my skin appearance or texture during this time. It was a nice lotion and I enjoyed using it, but again it was nothing special for me and how it fixed appearance or texture problems. I will enjoy continuing to use it as I finish up the product, but I wouldn't buy again since it is specifically supposed to fix creepiness and firmness problems in the skin.

This cream i use morning and night on my neck and face. I noticed a difference the next morning. It was subtle but definitely noticeable. I love how moisturizing it is as well. It gives the skin a soft feel and the texture is thin so it doesn't feel heavy on the face. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a cream like this one.

avis.titre: My neck and chest are so moisturized and soft.
avis.texte: I love this hydrating & firming cream for my neck, chest and face. It definitely helps with firming on my neck and chest. I do not have crepey skin on my face, so I can't review that. It is easy to apply and goes on smoothly. It absorbs quickly. You have to be consistent. I usually apply once a day. I will definitely continue to use it to see if I notice more changes over time. Easy to squeeze tube with a flip top lid.
